# The Markdown compiled into the crate as doctests, as git pathspecs.
#
# Read by rust-ci.yml's `changes` job, which runs `test` when one of these
# moves even though nothing else the native jobs read has, and by
# `just check-workflow-gates`. A page is compiled this way by a
# `#[doc = include_str!(...)]` under `#[cfg(doctest)]`; `src/lib.rs` holds the
# one there is.
